title: docs(pm): protocol-text family — five graded instruction-face additions, ratchet-paid (wave 4-B)
body:
Fixes #11109
Fixes #11083
Fixes #11135
Fixes #11119
Fixes #11298

Governed-surface PR (`.claude/**`): opened **draft** and stays draft — **human merge only**. No seat flips it ready, queues it, or arms auto-merge (Prime Directive 14; ACCEPT-path fork applies).

One graded family, one commit per member, every added line paid by in-place content compression — no ceiling raised, no re-wrap used as payment, no dated ruling or verbatim quote touched.

## Per member

- **#11109 (wording half)** — `SKILL.md`: both mislabel-report occurrences now state the composed rule 挂 `pm:retriage` + 异议评论同笔 (多仓协调 4 had 「留言上报」; Guardrails had the variant 「不改标签只上报误标」 — the second occurrence on current main is that variant spelling, verified before editing). Line-count neutral. The patrol-predicate half is wave 4-A's diff (Part of the same card there; not in this PR).
- **#11083 (direction 1)** — `SKILL.md` ACCEPT-path clause ③ extended in place: request review where possible; on the author-identity 422 ("Review cannot be requested from pull request author"), assign the PR to os-zhuang instead and say so in the round report. Line-count neutral.
- **#11135** — (a) `SKILL.md` landing funnel: queue-entry eligibility = every check on the PR green, not the required subset; incident distilled without IDs per the id-lint standard (required-green PR queued with a non-required gate red; that repo's main red for about an hour until fix-forward). In-place, line-count neutral. (b) New `references/true-green.md`: per-repo canonical test invocations, gates invisible to CI-log greps, local preflights — one line per fact. Pointer added in place inside `references/review-checklist.md`'s CI-convergence item (its two-required-jobs floor now explicitly distinguished from the all-checks bar). review-checklist stays at 82/82.
- **#11119 (cheap version)** — `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` Draft-PR clause: on a branch that will squash, declare the card relation once, in the PR body; keep card-relation trailers out of individual branch commits (the squash concatenates every commit message into one). Paid +2/−2 in the same file: the ablation disk-confirmation double incident narration condensed to its lesson, and one rhetorical elaboration dropped from the gate-exit-code clause. AGENTS.md deliberately untouched: it carries no closing-keyword clause to anchor the sentence and sits at 961/961 headroom 0, so the addition is not ratchet-neutral there — per the graded scope, os-dev.md alone.
- **#11298 (carries the #11196 ruling)** — `SKILL.md` state-model table: `pm:awaiting-maintainer` row — meaning (decision made; remaining action is a manual maintainer operation outside GitHub's reach), mutual exclusions (never coexists with `pm:queue`/`pm:dispatched`/`pm:blocked`/`pm:on-hold`/`needs-user-decision`), exit (maintainer performs the action; seat clears the label with an evidence comment in the same stroke; no machine exit by construction, carried as parked inventory). Patrol mechanics deliberately not restated — `check-half-states.mjs` is the enforcement authority (untouched here; wave 4-A owns it). Paid +1/−1: the standby-five list's duplicated parentheticals (each restated authoritatively in its home section) replaced with a pointer 「各项纪律以其主节为准,⛔ 此处不另抄」.

## Compression choices (why these were least load-bearing)

Every compressed passage restates a discipline whose authoritative copy lives elsewhere in the same file (standby-list parentheticals ← 发现分诊轮 / 状态模型 / 选择优先级) or narrates an incident twice where once carries the lesson (os-dev ablation narration, gate-exit-code rhetoric). No ruling text, no quote, no mechanism was removed.

## Ratchet verdicts (from the post-final-commit union at head 9710e92e)

- `check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is 682 lines (ceiling 682; headroom 0).`
- `check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/agents/os-dev.md is 405 lines (ceiling 405; headroom 0).`
- `check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md is 82 lines (ceiling 82; headroom 0).`
- `check-skill-line-ratchet: AGENTS.md is 961 lines (ceiling 961; headroom 0).` (untouched)

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (no paths passed; change set from merge-base, provenance line verified: objectstack tree at 9710e92e). 11 matched families, all run locally and green at head `9710e92e` (verdict lines from the gates' own output, exit captured before any pipe): check:agent-model-declared · check:doc-authoring · lint check:doc-formula-expressions (22 record-scoped examples clean) · check:nul-bytes · check:pm-governed-merges (self-test) · check:pm-governed-prose (2 surfaces name all 5 governed surfaces) · check:pm-skill-id-lint (18 files clean) · check:pm-skill-ratchet (all ceilings hold) · check:required-contexts (6 contexts pinned) · check:skill-frame-sync (4 copies isomorphic — frame copies untouched). First union run predated `pnpm install` and two gates died on module resolution with a misleading aggregate exit 0 — re-run one-command-per-line under set -e after install + `@objectstack/formula` build; the final union is the one quoted.

Docs-only `.claude/**` diff: `skip-changeset` applied per convention. New page ceiling-row follow-up filed separately: #11310 remains open for triage.
